reuse.why: Adds the flag once to the shared LinkAccountBaseParams / linkBankSyncAccount path that every provider link handler spreads into, and reuses the unlink field reset by extracting it from unlinkAccount rather than writing a new update.

duplication.why: The local unlink field reset is extracted into clearBankLink and called from both unlinkAccount and the replace path, so no block is copied.

placement.why: The takeover decision sits in linkBankSyncAccount right where the existing duplicate-link refusal lives, after the closed-account check, and the helper sits next to unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

scope.why: Only the parameter, the branch, the extracted helper, focused tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change with a comment explaining why the provider is not contacted; the unlink fields now have one definition shared by both paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared linkBankSyncAccount flow and the extracted clearBankLink rather than going around unlinkAccount's reset logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The db.updateAccount reset was moved into clearBankLink and removed from unlinkAccount, not copied.
